title: An Adaptive Sparse Matrix Compression CIM Accelerator based on 256Kb SOT-MRAM for Downlink Massive MIMO Communications
problem: Downlink precoding in massive MIMO systems involves high-dimensional sparse matrix calculations that existing architectures handle inefficiently; sparse computing for wireless communication remains underexplored in CIM designs.
motivation: 5G massive MIMO systems require efficient sparse matrix processing for precoding; CIM offers parallel processing advantages but sparse matrix handling is underexplored for wireless applications.
method: CIM accelerator based on SOT-MRAM with adaptive multi-sparse mode technology optimizes sparse matrix multiplication for MIMO precoding. The design minimizes storage requirements through adaptive compression and maximizes parallel processing speed using CIM's inherent parallelism.
key_novelty: First application of CIM technology for processing sparse matrices in MIMO precoding tasks with adaptive sparse mode optimization.
contributions: First CIM-based sparse matrix accelerator for MIMO precoding
limitations: Evaluation limited to specific MIMO configuration (32×256×8); SOT-MRAM scalability to larger matrices not discussed; wireless context narrow.
